description: This file defines the PdfAnnotations class, a collection managing annotations for PDF pages within the PdfSharp library. It provides methods to add, remove, clear, and access annotations, as well as iteration support. The class interacts with other PDF annotation types and the document's internal structures.

classes.name: PdfAnnotations
classes.description: Represents a collection of annotations on a PDF page, allowing management of individual annotations including adding, removing, and enumeration.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new PdfAnnotation to the collection and updates the document references accordingly.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified PdfAnnotation from the collection and updates the document references.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all annotations from the current page.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of annotations in the collection.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to access a specific annotation by index, returning a PdfAnnotation object.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to iterate through the annotations collection.
